Property.Name: mipi-sdw-sw-interface-revision
Property.Description: Version of this Specification whose Property definitions apply. This is intended to guard against any potential changes to the property definitions in future versions of this Specification (32-bit value). Bits 31-16: (Upper word) Major version number Bits 15-0: (Lower word) Minor version number This entry shall be provided if any other property entry within this structure is populated. Example: 0x00020001 indicates that the contained properties shall be interpreted according to the property definitions given in version 2.1 of this Specification.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-function-topology-features
Property.Description: A 64-bit mask describing optional features supported by this SDCA function. Please refer to SDCA specification for optional feature mask for each function. This property is required if any optional features are supported by this function.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-list
Property.Description: An integer containing one bit for each control selector present in this entity. Bit 0 maps to control selector 0, bit 18 maps to control selector 18, etc.

Package.Name: Sdca_ControlSelector
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each control selector. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer. n equals to each but that is set in mipi-sdca-control-selector-list, encoded as a capitalized hex number without any leading zeros (i.e. %X not %8X or %8x). See Table 19 Control Descriptor for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-entity-id-list
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each entity ID present in the SDCA function. e.g.Package() {0x1, 0x3, 0x4, 0x15, 0x8, 0x11}

Package.Name: Sdca_Entity
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each entity. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each entity id mentioned in mipi-sdca-entity-id-list. See Table 4 – Table 18 for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-cluster-id-list
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each cluster id. See the SDCA specification for details on the usage of this information. e.g.Package() {0x11, 0x23, 0x54, 0x55, 0x9, 0x12}

Package.Name: Sdca_Cluster
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each cluster. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each cluster id mentioned in mipi-sdca-cluster-id-list. See Table 25 Cluster Descriptor for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-opaqueset-rank
Property.Description: This integer (byte) describes whether opaque sets for this Function are single- or dual-ranked. This applies to all opaque sets described in mipi-sdca-opaqueset-id-list for this Function. 0: Single-Ranked 1: Dual-Ranked

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-opaqueset-id-list
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each opaque set ID present in the SDCA function. e.g. Package() {0x1, 0x3, 0x4, 0x15, 0x8, 0x11}

Package.Name: Sdca_Opaqueset
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each opaque set. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each opaque set id mentioned in mipi-sdca-opaque-set-id-list. See new table for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-string-table
Property.Description: This property refers to a string table encoded as a package. The format of the string table Package is defined in section 5.1.5.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-file-set-id-list
Property.Description: This property lists the list of file sets available for this Function. Entries in this list are encoded as Integers, expressed in hexadecimal format.

Package.Name: Sdca_Placeholder
Package.Description: This property provides a list of files that are permitted to be loaded into Entities within this Function, with reference to each file. n refers to the File Set Index provided by the mipi-sdca-file-set-id-list in the SDCA Specification and is encoded as a four-character string representing a hexadecimal number (0000-FFFF). See section 5.1.5 for a defintition of the SoundWire File Table. Package() { VendorID0, FileID0, File_Offset0, ... VendorID(n), FildID(n), File_Offset(n) }

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-behavior-set-id-list
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each behavior set ID present in the SDCA function. e.g. Package() {0x1, 0x3, 0x4, 0x15, 0x8, 0x11}

Package.Name: Sdca_Behaviorset
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each behavior set. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer and there shall be one entry for each behavior set id mentioned in mipi-sdca-behavior-set-id-list. See new table for package contents.

HierarchicalProperty.Name: mipi-sdca-function-expansion-subproperties
HierarchicalProperty.Description: See Table 24 Function Expansion Descriptor for package contents.

BufferProperty.Description: This property contains list of Soundwire registers’ addresses and values that need to be written to initialize an audio Function, in order. Conditions requiring this initialization is described in the [SDCA spec] The format of the buffer is pairs of 32-bit register address and 1 byte value. e.g. Buffer() { 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x02, 0x01, // Address: 0x02000001; write value: 0x01, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03, 0x55, // Address: 0x03000001; write value: 0x55, }
This property is required when the SDCA function device is of type HID, and not present otherwise. Please refer to USB HID spec for contents of this buffer.
